title: Kharge moves six charges against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, says 'no personal enmity', BJP accuses Congress of mocking Parliament | LIVE

ai.summary: Congress-led INDIA bloc publicly impeached Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter list tampering and election interference, claiming the CEC deleted 13.2 crore voters and conspired with Modi and Shah.

facts.claim: the CEC conspired with Modi and Shah
facts.quote: acted at the behest of Narendra Modi and Amit Shah

ai.background_note: Congress-led INDIA bloc initiated symbolic impeachment of CEC over alleged voter list tampering and election interference, claiming the CEC deleted 13.2 crore voters and conspired with Modi and Shah.
